prs.body:
This completes the many-worlds research round above VOYAGER: 48 expedition dossiers and 12 subsequent cross-domain studies, integrated into a navigable mathematical atlas with exact source contracts, proofs, counterexamples, receipts, and ranked next obstructions.

Start with [the mathematical atlas](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/759c30c72a2927212cdbfa41365800da96e5d515/research/2026-10-13/SWARM_ATLAS/SUCC_MATHEMATICAL_ATLAS.md), [mission index](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/759c30c72a2927212cdbfa41365800da96e5d515/research/2026-10-13/SWARM_ATLAS/MISSION_INDEX.md), and [branch map](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/759c30c72a2927212cdbfa41365800da96e5d515/research/2026-10-13/SWARM_ATLAS/BRANCH_MAP.md).

### Mathematical scope

- Seven new Lean modules cover the actual product-topology inverse-limit/closure theorem, compact actualization, general relation repair/base change, and narrower completion-transport, affine-stability, finite-support, memory, and compact-stopping cores. Lean 4.14.0 and mathlib `4bbdccd9c5f862bf90ff12f0a9e2c8be032b9a84` are pinned in an isolated package.
- Paper theorems connect original/current joint instruments, causal histories, stochastic continuation simulation, obstruction-preserving synthesis, observable algebras, memory, and analytic actualization. Finite exact probes corroborate their stated scopes; they do not replace their proofs.
- Independent audits preserved two substantive corrections: grammar-relative unsatisfiable cores need original-source certification before general caching (X03); deterministic history recovery requires deterministic initial preparation (X07). Both have counterexamples and regression coverage.
- General renormalization (D26), completed Weil-form identification (E38), and the universal history sheaf (F48) remain open/blocked at their named missing steps. Unrestricted constructor invention is conjectural. No RH advance or academic priority is claimed.

### Execution and validation

Exactly **21 genuine child agents**: six cohort investigators covering eight missions each, twelve synthesis investigators, and three fresh reviewers. All 60 investigations completed; this is not 48 independently spawned agents or 60 proved conjectures.

Final local validation on Python 3.12.14:

- **1,816 tests passed**, including both audit regressions.
- **18 exact receipts reproduced**.
- **72 provenance items verified**; required foundations and ordinal probes passed.
- **Seven new Lean modules compiled**; own-source placeholder/local-axiom gate passed. Eight baseline EODCS modules remain unchanged.
- Final source fingerprints and raw logs: [FINAL_VALIDATION.json](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/759c30c72a2927212cdbfa41365800da96e5d515/research/2026-10-13/SWARM_ATLAS/FINAL_VALIDATION.json); formal scopes and hashes: [FINAL_KERNEL_RECEIPT.json](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/759c30c72a2927212cdbfa41365800da96e5d515/research/2026-10-13/SWARM_ATLAS/FINAL_KERNEL_RECEIPT.json).

**Final-head GitHub CI passed**, including full Python 3.10/3.13 validation, all 18 receipt replays on both versions, and the pinned Lean/mathlib build. Both push and pull-request runs succeeded: [SUCC swarm isolated proof kernels (pull_request)](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38366077942); [Observational SUCC validation (pull_request)](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38366077858); [SUCC swarm isolated proof kernels (push)](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38366070787); [Observational SUCC validation (push)](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38366070675).

### Checkpoints and integration boundary

- VOYAGER base: `5eb09e7cba36ec01b8f9d6834b78b5766fd93935`.
- First durable checkpoint: `3e0efe08a314fd50e308d96d6de6b806e79e3568`.
- All-expedition checkpoint: `2e1bda55799e1e1f2c516e472c4fa169fc9692f8`.
- Final published head: `759c30c72a2927212cdbfa41365800da96e5d515`.
- Final tree: `a47ec3a50c95c2a5356c51b5ab00c8355815c4eb`, verified identical to local integration `5274e6f39711aaa5aae9b7b7b9b3544cda7f26f5`.

This remains a draft on the VOYAGER research branch. PR45 was compared file by file and theorem by theorem, not merged wholesale; its Lean 4.19 environment remains separate. No main merge, force push, release, tag, archival-provenance change, or existing-default change.

# CARRIER FIRST — make the existing source-indexed carrier the common mathematical host

**Draft PR #53**, based on the completed and independently validated **48+12 Atlas PR #50** at `759c30c72a2927212cdbfa41365800da96e5d515`. This branch is **NOT** merged to main. It deliberately does **NOT** modify live rolling swarm PR #49 or its original child worktrees.

## What we actually proved and implemented

**Canonical source-indexed carrier object:** immutable original labels S, changing current carrier C_h, actual public history h, exact stochastic joint instrument `K_a(c;receipt,c')`, enabled action menus, and an **UNNORMALIZED** `J_h(original,current)`. This retains event evidence and the source-current correlation after destructive observations.

**All-prior lawful quotient criterion:** Current-state quotient `q_h` can transport a full joint receipt/next-state instrument iff (1) enabledness descends on q-fibers, and (2) the complete joint `(receipt,q_(h+1)(next))` law is fiber-constant. A finite reindexing identity gives equality of unnormalized source-indexed laws and receipt likelihoods, hence original-source posteriors and target-support certificates throughout every composable ACTUAL finite path. Adaptive selections are covered conditionally when based only on shared public history and every selected square is checked. The rational stochastic sum identity is a **classical paper proof with exact independent finite oracles**, not fully mechanized Python refinement.

**Formal Lean 4.14:** `formal/EODCS_CarrierIndexed.lean` kernel-checks deterministic original index preservation, all-word report/endpoint naturality, original support/target transport under current-only projection, and comparison composition. It does NOT prove stochastic finite-sum reindexing inside Lean or solve sheaf gluing.

**Canonical repairs:** `repair_one_step` gives the coarsest report refinement that determines supplied action enabledness and complete future joint-row signatures; `minimal_stationary_repair` computes the unique coarsest stable finite strong-lumpability refinement, with exact counterexample causes and no claim to create a physical sensor. Both use complete source tables.

**Three honest perspectives:** deterministic Dirac actions → positive-support relation → exact joint probability law. The forgetful projection to support cannot recover weights; equal marginals and equal support are both inadequate for lawful stochastic transport.

**Bridges rather than replacement:** Tested adapters for completed #50 F48 `LawfulSource/HistoryFiber` and C17 `StochasticHistory`, while existing `Engine`, `ControlledCarrier`, category repair and VOYAGER remain intact. Attempting to treat a previous stochastic receipt history as a new lossless root is refused. Actual event replay is keyed by source, stage names and epochs, so two actions named `read` cannot be silently interchanged.

## Reproducibility / formal validity

- [Carrier theorem dossier](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/carrier-indexed-unification-2026-10-13/research/2026-10-13/CARRIER_INDEXED_HISTORY_THEORY.md)
- [Claims CAR-01…CAR-21](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/carrier-indexed-unification-2026-10-13/docs/CLAIM_SUPPLEMENT_CARRIER.md)
- [Frozen original-source scientific receipt](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/carrier-indexed-unification-2026-10-13/research/2026-10-13/CARRIER_INDEXED_SOURCE_RECEIPT.json) — generated from real successful Python 3.10/3.13 GitHub CI, and replayed byte-for-byte at exact head
- **156 dedicated tests passed on each of Python 3.10 and 3.13**, including 180 independent seeded finite original/joint kernel oracles, 90 exhaustive four-state complete-partition minimality checks, destructive source/history, repeated action names, stochastic-vs-support countermodels, and typed invalid-source/access/receipt mutations. [Run 38381168759](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38381168759).
- **Pinned Lean kernel gate passed**, [run 38381168618](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38381168618).
- Whole repository matrix on same exact head: [run 38381168776](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38381168776), separately check final status before merger.

## The promised Claude `main` handoff (NOT executed here)

- [Full WIP-safe integration plan](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/carrier-indexed-unification-2026-10-13/docs/CARRIER_MAIN_INTEGRATION_HANDOFF.md)
- [Point-in-time snapshot of main, every PR40–53 and 43 individual swarm child branches](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/blob/research/carrier-indexed-unification-2026-10-13/research/2026-10-13/CARRIER_SWARM_BRANCH_SNAPSHOT.json)

An eventual explicitly authorized Claude merge must first integrate the dependent #40→#41→#42→#43→#44→#46→#47→#48 research lineage, completed #50, this carrier child, completed Cambrian #51, and selectively audited EOS #45/F41 #52, preserving Lean 4.19 as its OWN package. **Rolling #49 is active WIP**: freeze only after its workers finish; never merge its unverified child heads or delete their original histories. Run exact-source, provenance, full Python and both formal-toolchain gates on a new integration SHA before pushing `main`. Main, release, defaults and archives remain unchanged here.

**Boundaries:** no physical source authentication, actual counterfactual measurement, unrestricted mathematical syntax invention, universal lawful causal-history sheaf, complete stochastic Lean refinement, completed Weil/Suzuki positivity or RH proof.
### Final exact-head full-suite verification — PASS

At `9e7589e522aff990189aa8a14f6ee2fa5a28dd81`, **GitHub Actions full repository CI completed successfully**, [run 38381168776](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38381168776), on Python 3.10 and 3.13. Each full mathematical suite reports **1,839 passing tests**; the workflow additionally completed its **41-test** and **37-test** specialized suites on both Python versions, source-provenance/foundations/ordinal checks, and all other source/math/heuristic guards. The independent dedicated EODCS/carrier gate passed **156 tests on each Python version** ([run 38381168759](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38381168759)) and Lean 4.14 kernel verification passed ([38381168618](https://github.com/femboy2112/SUCC/actions/runs/38381168618)). Both real-execution frozen carrier source receipts replayed exactly. The branch remains **draft** and is NOT main integration; the still-moving rolling swarm #49 must be reassessed at Claude integration time.
